description: This file contains functions for converting IPv4 and IPv6 addresses from presentation to network format, including implementation of inet_pton4, inet_pton6, and a wrapper inet_pton. It also includes related macros and constants.

methods.name: inet_pton4
methods.description: Converts IPv4 address from presentation to network format, validating dotted quad notation.

methods.name: inet_pton6
methods.description: Converts IPv6 address from presentation to network format, handling IPv6 notation and embedded IPv4 addresses.

methods.name: inet_pton
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls inet_pton4 or inet_pton6 based on address family.
